name: thread-memory
description: Maintain persistent Codex thread notes and retrieve details from local rollout history.

interface.longDescription: Maintain notes across Codex context compaction. Main-thread forks receive their own copies, and subagents start with fresh notes. Use $thread-memory to update notes or find messages, instructions, tool details, and image or audio attachments in accessible local rollouts. Browse main-thread notes in Codex Desktop.
